notes.title: 3rd Anniversary Major Update Incoming !
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/f986f9f660c3ee8a7713e7397f3e371fcace8f87.png"]
The 3rd Anniversary Major Update For Retro Abyss Is Coming On Friday, October 3th !
Here’s what to expect in this update:

A completely overhauled New Game Plus system

New attack patterns for all bosses (including the final boss) in NORMAL and HARD difficulty

"Candy of Cooldown" – reduce cooldown times by up to 95%

"Ultimate Skill Upgrade" – take your ultimate skill to the next level

"Treasure Upgrade" – now reworked to apply to all classes

Faster progression through 3 new quest types

Perfect balance tuning to highlight each class’s strengths and synergies

Boss Time attack system and restoration of easter eggs

Complete removal of first-person narration and dialogue windows during gameplay

A deeper and more coherent metafiction storyline

Enhanced game support: saturation adjustment, reset options, gamepad aiming fixes, and more

If time permits, I also plan to post some behind-the-scenes / developer notes and cut story content that wasn’t included in the main game !


[previewyoutube="39CVSsJDe5Y;full"][/previewyoutube]In Addition, 3 New Games Are Currently In Development !
Wingless Hero - An experimental 2D action platformer with procedurally generated levels, focusing on chaining jumps and attacks.

Astro Invaders - A 3d shoot em up game built around minimal controls and a boss fight focused structure.

Both titles are already 100% complete and planned for release within the year.
Each game emphasizes creative mechanics and simple fun, with stories revealed after clearing the game.

Also in development is - New Super Bird & Adventure a project that brings together all the experience gained from developing Retro Abyss and past titles.



Please look forward to the major update on October 3rd, as well as the upcoming new games !

notes.title: 2.0.32 Balancing / New Game Plus Improvement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/f8ecac394538aaec3e83ea8c8e925ac03aae84cc.png

Based on feedback from beta testers and those who upload videos and reviews from around the world, we've released a patch that increases the difficulty of boss fights to the initial level and increases the rewards.

Here are the details

2.0.32 Balancing / New Game Plus Improvement

All bosses have been rolled back to their initial launch difficulty, with the exception of Traitors and Cerberus Dragon.

The Sunken Pirate King now uses chopping pattern more often in second phase.

Increased the health of the final boss to the level we initially envisioned.

The final boss's defense against Lasthale is increased in the third phase.

class / upgrade balance Rolled backed to 1.4.x.

Increased the cost of reviving in the second area.

Increased the amount of keys awarded for clearing each difficulty by 1

Increased coin drops on Normal and Hard difficulties by 25% and 50%, respectively.

Potion of Health and Meat Of power have been changed to increase their base level in addition to the maximum level of their amplification upgrade.

Characters will no longer be deleted at the start of new game plus.

The rewards in the first area will be changed in the second round and will be awarded immediately without the need to spin the roulette wheel, and the amount of coins in the first area will be increased.

The Secret Shop is now immediately accessible from new game plus.

The Magician's card explosion effect has been changed to be smoother.

Various other bug fixes

Please note that some of the above updates will only take effect after you pass the current round of new game plus.

If you happen to find any bugs in the new update, please leave a comment or send an email to BenBigGameStudio@Gmail.Com and we will fix them as soon as possible!

We hope you're having a great time and thank you !

notes.title: Final Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/40275368c4fd0ae71d1551b92a52af39366b31e1.png

Now all content is 100% complete. Three episodes have been updated, including a special defense boss battle, various cut scenes, optional system leading to a bad ending, and final boss battle.
The ultimate skill "Last Hale" has been added. The acquisition conditions are tricky, but the skill's power is the strongest.
Added 9 types of "final angle classes" that can only be used in the last battle.
Added episode play function and arcade game mode.
Try your limits by challenging hard difficulty!
Contents such as key quests, epilogue collection, and special secret stores have been added.
Now you have upgraded your treasure and it's available for multiple uses. In the previous update, those who bought the King of the Sea boot have upgraded all three treasures for free.
Remade the Summoner Class as a Combat Class, not a Support Class. The skill adjustment and uplift were made accordingly.
New features are added to the clueless Paladin class: "Faster travel speed compared to other characters" and "Fast cool time, a little weak attack."
Other classes have increased aggression or physical strength in common.
Increase visibility by changing the color of some skills.
The addition of a true final boss has slightly lowered the pattern difficulty of some bosses.
Some of the lines in the cut scene before the final boss might not be understood because Retro Abyss has added a little reboot to make it work as a story. If you value the story, please play the story mode again on New Game Plus!
The appearance of "The Dead Pirate King" has been strengthened, and the boss's aggression has increased.
The cut scene production of "The Acrobats of Wonderland" has been enhanced, and the spinning pattern through hypnosis has been changed to the wavering pattern. (To minimize the difference in avoidance difficulty according to the screen ratio.)
Five additional stories and cut scenes have been added for classic level bosses.
The classical level has been reduced to 10 levels, leaving only the best-made levels, and the speed of enemies has increased, and the difficulty and rewards have increased a little.
The support class's equipment customization capabilities have been enhanced to allow you to wear a Kunai of Power to increase your attack power.
The physical shield has been changed to an exclusive product available in coins at the equipment store, giving you an additional 10000 physical strength in total when you wear two.
Legendary equipment dedicated to support classes "Retrohale (shield)" has been added, and the legend equipment of the existing support classes has been replaced with it.
Entry conditions in the second area have been relaxed to 3 LV MAX characters.
(Entry from the start of the second round)
Coins of bosses in the second area have been changed to Fixed Drop.
Earn 1.5x coins when you clear no damage.
Changed the title screen to automatically change to match the stage you played.
Various systems have changed in the last version, and we have removed some previously supported content and features for stability and completeness. Please understand.
We have added official translations of English and Japanese stories.
We have added a new loading screen and ending screen illustration.
Countless bug fixes.

Future plan: This month, we will fix the upcoming bugs, do some stability updates, and promote my current best, "Retro Abyss: Last Wish Of The Game" here and there.
We can also do a "bonus update" if it's possible.

Hope you have a good time in the final update!
And thank you so much for joining us until the final update!

notes.title: What is the game's last wish...? Retro Abyss final update preview !
notes.content:
"The Final Chapter" will take the game to the next level!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/45e9c3598c204b64ae0e56772c19e611cd19bd41.png
The 9 final awakened classes, the ultimate skill that can shake the entire abyss, and the true final boss that weaves all the stories together are already completed.
A plot twist that reveals the true theme of the game and a special ending that can only be seen in Retro Abyss is currently in development!

When the game is complete, experience it yourself without spoilers!

The final boss you just defeated was the weakest of us!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/3a45c2f178d5dda13958c221a84a98bb3c9f1cae.png
Quite a few people think that the level 15 fake final boss, Poseidon, is the end of the game. To lead them deeper into the abyss, we have taken feedback from various players and significantly improved the early level 15 gameplay! 
The number of characters limited to entering the latter half of the area has been reduced to 3, more interesting rewards have been provided, and story elements have been strengthened by adding 5 cutscenes that hint at powerful bosses deeper in the abyss!

It is safe to say that all the shortcomings suggested by users have been improved without significantly harming the early gameplay!

When will the update comes?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759844/b0226dcb5826272eb7d2e92d90c43cda03626434.png
The goal is to complete this update before the end of July, but it may take a little longer to achieve perfection.

"Retro Abyss: Last Wish of The Game" will be reborn with the final update. so stay tuned!
